name: Shkol'naja istorija ljubvi Chapter 3
source:
Summer is in full swing! Our heroine and her friends — Izumi, Meiko, Akihiro, Kenshi, Tekumi, and Hiroshi — hit the road again. Their destination: the scenic Lake Biwa. But instead of relaxing, the group ends up in a lost place that isn't on any map. No signal. No help in sight. Silence. Fog. And a shadow moving through the trees…

A coincidence — or something sinister? Can they uncover the truth behind this strange place? And what trials of love await them along the way?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrionStudio.Anime_School_Love_Story_3]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
夏天正如火如荼地进行！我们的女主人公和她的朋友——泉、芽美子、秋宏、剑士、特美和宏——再次上路。他们的目的地：风景秀丽的琵琶湖。但一行人并没有放松下来，而是来到了一个地图上没有的迷失之地。无信号。看不到任何帮助。沉默。多雾路段。还有一个影子在树林里移动……

是巧合——还是有什么险恶的事情？他们能揭开这个奇怪地方背后的真相吗？一路上又会遇到怎样的爱情考验呢？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrionStudio.Anime_School_Love_Story_3]Google Play[/url]]
